name: 质量（标准/检测/保障）体系

map.输入婚礼服务各环节质量评分，综合评估服务质量等级和客户满意度: Enter quality ratings for each part of the wedding service to assess the overall service level and customer satisfaction
map.📖 查看「质量（标准/检测/保障）体系 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Wedding Service Quality Scorecard" guide
map.婚礼服务综合得分按环节加权：专业度 25% + 守时性 20% + 创意度 20: The overall wedding-service score is a weighted total across areas: professionalism 25% + punctuality 20% + creativity 20% + communication 20% + cost control 15%. Each is rated out of 10 and converted to a percentage. A total of 90 or above is excellent, 80–89 good, 70–79 acceptable and below 70 needs improvement. Customer satisfaction is the total ÷ 100 × 5 as a five-star rating, and the lowest-scoring area should be improved first.
map.📚 深度解析：婚礼服务质量评估: 📚 In depth: assessing wedding service quality
map.婚礼结束后按策划、场地、摄影、化妆、司仪等环节逐项评分，量化整体服务质量。: After the wedding, rate planning, venue, photography, makeup and the MC item by item to quantify overall service quality.
map.签约前用它明确供应商的考核维度，把评分标准写进合同。: Before signing, use it to define how suppliers will be assessed and write the scoring criteria into the contract.
map.婚庆公司做内部复盘，找出评分最低的环节做专项改进。: Wedding companies can use it for internal reviews, spotting the lowest-rated area for targeted improvement.
map.摄影摄像环节的评分: Scoring the photography and videography area
map.专业性 9、准时性 8、创意性 8、沟通响应 9、合同履约率 95%：综合 =: Professionalism 9, punctuality 8, creativity 8, communication 9, contract fulfilment 95%: overall = 9×0.30 + 8×0.20 + 8×0.20 + 9×0.15 + (95÷10)×0.15 = 2.70 + 1.60 + 1.60 + 1.35 + 1.425 = 8.68 → "excellent (four stars)". If punctuality fell to 5, the overall score drops to 8.08 — still excellent, but close to the good band.
map.各维度的权重是多少？: What are the weights of each dimension?
map.专业性 30%、准时性 20%、创意性 20%、沟通响应 15%、合同履约率 1: Professionalism 30%, punctuality 20%, creativity 20%, communication 15% and contract fulfilment 15%. Professionalism and punctuality carry the most weight because they affect the day itself most directly.
map.评分参照什么标准？: What standard is the scoring based on?
map.维度设置参照婚礼服务行业规范（页面标注 SB/T 10957）。等级划分：≥9: The dimensions follow the wedding-service industry standard (SB/T 10957, noted on the page). Grades: ≥9 outstanding (five stars), ≥8 excellent (four stars), ≥7 good (three stars), ≥6 acceptable (two stars) and <6 unsatisfactory.
map.婚庆服务质量评估参考SB/T 10957《婚庆服务规范》: Quality assessment follows SB/T 10957, the Chinese standard for wedding services
map.合同履约率是关键指标，低于90%应启动质量整改: Contract fulfilment is a key indicator; below 90% should trigger a quality review
map.建议婚前3个月、1个月、1周分阶段评估: Assess in stages: 3 months, 1 month and 1 week before the wedding
map.摄影摄像应关注设备等级、备份方案和后期交付: For photography and videography, look at equipment grade, backup arrangements and post-production delivery
map.保留沟通记录和合同附件作为质量追溯依据: Keep communication records and contract attachments as evidence for quality follow-up
map.婚庆服务质量评估工具，从专业性、准时性、创意性、沟通响应、合同履约率五个维度综合: A wedding-service quality assessment tool that scores across five dimensions — professionalism, punctuality, creativity, communication responsiveness and contract fulfilment — and assigns a service grade.
